from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyAccountsPayable(BaseModel):
    """Accounts payable information extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the document")
    accounts_payable: float | None = Field(description="The accounts payable amount from the balance sheet")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The period this data covers, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g., '元'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_accounts_payable: list[CompanyAccountsPayable]
